Update [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Collateral_Valuations]
Set npvScore = CASE WHEN abs(npvValue) between 0 and 100000 then '1'
					  WHEN abs(npvValue) between 100000.01 and 250000.99 then '2'
					  WHEN   abs(npvValue) between 250001.00 and 500000.99 then '3'
					  WHEN   abs(npvValue) between 500001.00 and 2000000.99 then '4'
					ELSE '5'
				END,
	collateralizationScore = CASE WHEN collateralizationType='FLCL' THEN '0'
							  WHEN collateralizationType ='PRCL' THEN '1'
							  WHEN collateralizationType ='UNCL' THEN '2'
							END
WHERE CAST(loadDate as Date) = CAST(GETDATE() as Date)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Collateral_Valuations]
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

SELECT C.weekEndingDate 
	  ,C.foTradeId
      ,C.sourceSystem
      ,C.npvValue
      ,C.npvScore
      ,C.npvDate
      ,C.npvCurrency
      ,C.productType
      ,C.collateralizationType
      ,C.collateralizationScore
      ,C.ageOfTrade
      ,C.ageScore
      ,C.daysInStage
      ,C.counterparty
      ,C.product
      ,C.tradeEvent
      ,C.pegaStage
      ,C.latestComment
      ,C.marketer
      ,C.trader
      ,C.processingOrg
      ,C.externalChasers
	  ,C.totalScore
	  ,CASE WHEN C.totalScore > 8 then 'Red'
		WHEN C.totalScore between 6 and 8 then 'Amber'
		WHEN C.totalScore <6 then 'Green' 
	   END AS [status]
FROM (SELECT A.weekEndingDate
	  ,A.TradeId AS foTradeId
      ,B.sourceSystem
      ,B.npvValue
      ,CASE WHEN B.npvScore IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE B.npvScore END AS npvScore

      ,A.ageOfTrade

      ,A.daysInStage
      ,A.counterparty
      ,A.product
      ,A.tradeEvent
      ,A.pegaStage
      ,A.latestComment
      ,A.marketer
      ,A.trader
      ,A.processingOrg
      ,A.externalChasers
      ,sum(A.[ageScore] 
				+ CASE WHEN B.collateralizationScore IS NULL THEN '2' ELSE B.collateralizationScore END 
				+ CASE WHEN B.npvScore IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE B.npvScore END) as totalScore

	LEFT OUTER JOIN ReconControl.dbo.[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Collateral_Valuations] B

	  ,A.TradeId

      ,B.npvDate

      ,B.collateralizationType
      ,B.collateralizationScore
      ,A.ageOfTrade
      ,A.ageScore
      ,A.daysInStage
      ,A.counterparty
      ,A.product
      ,A.tradeEvent
      ,A.pegaStage
      ,A.latestComment
      ,A.marketer
      ,A.trader
      ,A.processingOrg
      ,A.externalChasers) C;

EXEC dbo.TruncateTable @TableName = 'dbo.tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Unconfirmed_Equities_View' ;

WITH Mercury
AS
(
	SELECT DISTINCT A.weekEndingDate, A.tradeID, B.ParentProductId, B.HoldID
	FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Unconfirmed_Equities] A
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Mercury_TableAll] B on A.tradeID = B.ParentProductId 
	AND B.HoldID is not NULL
	
)
,


NPVValue
AS
(
	Select A.weekEndingDate, A.tradeID,  SUM(C.npvValue) AS npvValue
	FROM Mercury A 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ReconControl.dbo.[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Collateral_Valuations] C
		ON A.HoldID = C.holdId AND A.weekEndingDate = C.weekEndingDate
	GROUP BY A.weekEndingDate, A.TradeId
)
,


NPVSource
AS
(
	Select DISTINCT A.weekEndingDate, A.tradeID,  Min(C.holdId) as HoldId,  Min(C.npvDate) as npvDate, Min(C.npvCurrency) as npvCurrency , 
			Min(C.collateralizationType) as collateralizationType, Min(C.collateralizationScore) as collateralizationScore, Min(C.sourceSystem) as sourceSystem
	FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Unconfirmed_Equities]  A
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Mercury B ON A.tradeID = B.ParentProductId AND A.weekEndingDate = B.weekEndingDate
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ReconControl.dbo.[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Collateral_Valuations] C
		ON B.HoldID = C.holdId AND B.weekEndingDate = C.weekEndingDate
	GROUP BY A.weekEndingDate, A.tradeID

)

SELECT X.weekEndingDate 
	  ,X.foTradeId
      ,X.sourceSystem
      ,X.npvValue
      ,X.npvScore
      ,X.npvDate
      ,X.npvCurrency
      ,X.collateralizationType
      ,X.collateralizationScore
      ,X.ageOfTrade
      ,X.ageScore
      ,X.daysInStage
      ,X.counterparty
      ,X.product
      ,X.tradeEvent
      ,X.pegaStage
      ,X.latestComment
      ,X.marketer
      ,X.trader
      ,X.processingOrg
      ,X.externalChasers
	  ,X.TotalScore
	  ,CASE WHEN X.totalScore > 8 then 'Red'
		WHEN X.totalScore between 6 and 8 then 'Amber'
		WHEN X.totalScore <6 then 'Green' 
	   END AS [status]
FROM (
		SELECT C.weekEndingDate 
			  ,C.foTradeId
			  ,C.sourceSystem
			  ,C.npvValue
			  ,C.npvScore
			  ,C.npvDate
			  ,C.npvCurrency
			  ,C.collateralizationType
			  ,C.collateralizationScore
			  ,C.ageOfTrade
			  ,C.ageScore
			  ,C.daysInStage
			  ,C.counterparty
			  ,C.product
			  ,C.tradeEvent
			  ,C.pegaStage
			  ,C.latestComment
			  ,C.marketer
			  ,C.trader
			  ,C.processingOrg
			  ,C.externalChasers
			  ,(C.[ageScore] + C.collateralizationScore + C.npvScore) AS TotalScore
		FROM (
				SELECT A.weekEndingDate
					,A.TradeId AS foTradeId
					,C.sourceSystem
					,D.npvValue
					,CASE WHEN D.npvValue IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE  
						CASE WHEN abs(D.npvValue) between 0 and 100000 then '1'
							  WHEN abs(D.npvValue) between 100000.01 and 250000.99 then '2'
							  WHEN   abs(D.npvValue) between 250001.00 and 500000.99 then '3'
							  WHEN   abs(D.npvValue) between 500001.00 and 2000000.99 then '4'
							ELSE '5'
						END
					END AS npvScore
					,C.npvDate
					,C.npvCurrency
					,C.collateralizationType
					,CASE WHEN C.collateralizationScore IS NULL THEN '2' ELSE C.collateralizationScore END AS collateralizationScore
					,A.ageOfTrade
					,A.ageScore
					,A.daysInStage
					,A.counterparty
					,A.product
					,A.tradeEvent
					,A.pegaStage
					,A.latestComment
					,A.marketer
					,A.trader
					,A.processingOrg
					,A.externalChasers
			FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_ConfirmationPlatform_TPE_Unconfirmed_Equities]  A
					LEFT OUTER JOIN NPVSource C  ON A.tradeID = C.tradeID AND A.weekEndingDate = C.weekEndingDate 
					LEFT OUTER JOIN NPVValue D ON A.tradeID = D.tradeID AND A.weekEndingDate = D.weekEndingDate 
				) C
		
		)X
